AddImageMosaic.description_en: Adds mosaics, Gaussian blurs, or solid color shapes to blur one or more areas of an image for privacy protection and saves the output image to the specified path in Object Storage Service (OSS)
AddImageMosaic.description_zh: 在一张图片的一个或多个特定区域内添加多种形状的马赛克、高斯模糊或纯色块，并将填充后的图片保存到指定的OSS文件对象地址。该功能主要用于隐私保护

AttachOSSBucket.description_en: Binds an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket to the specified project. The binding enables you to use IMM features by using the x-oss-process parameter
AttachOSSBucket.description_zh: 将OSS Bucket与IMM Project绑定，可以通过OSS x-oss-process方式使用IMM的数据处理能力

BatchDeleteFileMeta.description_en: Deletes the metadata of multiple files from a dataset
BatchDeleteFileMeta.description_zh: 批量从数据集内删除文件的元信息

BatchGetFigureCluster.description_zh: 批量获取人物聚类及其信息

BatchGetFileMeta.description_en: Queries metadata of multiple objects or files in the specified dataset
BatchGetFileMeta.description_zh: 批量获取数据集内已完成索引的文件的元数据

BatchIndexFileMeta.description_en: This operation performs a batch index of object metadata by processing input files for tasks such as label detection, face detection, and location detection. The object metadata is then indexed into a dataset to support various data retrieval methods
BatchIndexFileMeta.description_zh: 批量索引文件元信息。对输入的文件进行数据处理如标签识别、人脸检测、地点检测等，并将文件元信息索引到数据集内，支持多样化的数据检索

BatchUpdateFileMeta.description_en: Updates some metadata items of files indexed into a dataset
BatchUpdateFileMeta.description_zh: 更新批量数据集内已索引的文件的部分元数据

CompareImageFaces.description_en: Compares the similarity of the largest faces in two images. The largest face refers to the largest face frame in an image after face detection
CompareImageFaces.description_zh: 比较两张图片中最大的人脸的相似度。最大的人脸指的是图片经人脸检测后，所有人脸框中面积最大的

ContextualAnswer.description_en: Phase II of AI Assistant, Q\&A API
ContextualAnswer.description_zh: AI助手的问答API，用于生成对话中的问答内容，能够根据上下文提供相关的回答

ContextualRetrieval.description_en: Retrieves semantically similar documents. The operation is designed for multi-turn conversations and can process message input in historical conversations. The operation returns results that are highly related to the current conversation based on an in-depth understanding of contextual content. It provides consistent and efficient information retrieval in multi-turn conversations
ContextualRetrieval.description_zh: 检索API专为多轮对话场景设计，能够处理包含对话历史的消息输入，精准检索语义相近文档。通过深度解析上下文信息，该接口确保检索结果与当前对话内容高度相关，适用于复杂交互环境，为多轮对话提供一致且高效的信息检索服务

CreateArchiveFileInspectionTask.description_en: Creates a task to inspect a compressed file and retrieve a list of its contents without decompressing the file
CreateArchiveFileInspectionTask.description_zh: 创建压缩包预览解析任务支持获取压缩包内的文件列表信息，该功能无需解压压缩包，就可以获取压缩包内的文件列表信息

CreateBatch.description_en: Creates a batch processing task that performs specified operations, such as transcoding and format conversion, on multiple existing files
CreateBatch.description_zh: 创建一个批处理任务。指定存储内已存在的若干文件，对其批量执行指定操作，如转码、格式转换等

CreateBinding.description_en: Creates a binding relationship between a dataset and an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket. This allows for the automatic synchronization of incremental and full data and indexing
CreateBinding.description_zh: 创建数据集（Dataset）和对象存储（OSS）Bucket的绑定关系，自动同步全量和增量文件并为其索引

CreateCompressPointCloudTask.description_en: Compresses point cloud data stored in Object Storage Service (OSS) to reduce network data transmission
CreateCompressPointCloudTask.description_zh: 点云压缩功能可以将OSS中的点云数据进行压缩处理。减少网络数据传输

CreateCustomizedStory.description_en: Creates a story based on the specified images and videos
CreateCustomizedStory.description_zh: 使用选择的图片和视频创建一个故事

CreateFacesSearchingTask.description_en: Searches a media set for the top N images most similar to a specified image or face ID. The operation returns the corresponding face IDs and bounding boxes, sorted by similarity in descending order
CreateFacesSearchingTask.description_zh: 从媒体集中搜索与指定图片或人脸ID最相似的前N张图片，并返回相应人脸ID及边界框。返回结果按照相似度降序排列

CreateFigureClusteringTask.description_en: Creates a figure clustering task. This task uses an intelligent algorithm to group the faces of different people in images that are indexed in a dataset
CreateFigureClusteringTask.description_zh: 创建一个人物人脸聚类任务，通过智能算法，可以在您已索引到数据集的图片中，将属于不同人物的人脸进行聚类分组

CreateFigureClustersMergingTask.description_en: Merges two or more figure clustering groups into a single figure clustering group
CreateFigureClustersMergingTask.description_zh: 将两个或两个以上人物聚类分组合并为一个人物聚类分组

CreateFileUncompressionTask.description_en: A file decompression task lets you decompress specific files or an entire compressed package to a specified location. Supported formats include Zip, RAR, and 7z
CreateFileUncompressionTask.description_zh: 创建解压缩任务可以将您压缩包内的指定文件解压缩到特定位置，也可以将压缩包完整解压，目前支持的压缩格式包括Zip、RAR和7z

CreateHighlightTask.description_en: Creates a video highlight task. This feature is in invitational preview

CreateImageModerationTask.description_en: Detects non-compliant content in images, such as pornography, terrorism, undesirable scenes, logos, and text-in-image violations
CreateImageModerationTask.description_zh: 检测图片内容是否合规，包括色情内容、暴恐涉政、不良场景、logo、图文违规这几种检测场景

CreateImageSplicingTask.description_en: Stitches multiple images into a single image based on specified rules and saves the output to a specified OSS object
CreateImageSplicingTask.description_zh: 将多张图片按设定的规则拼接成一张图片，并保存到指定的OSS文件对象地址

CreateImageToPDFTask.description_en: Converts multiple images into a single PDF file and saves the file as a specified OSS object
CreateImageToPDFTask.description_zh: 将多张图片转换为单个PDF文件，并保存到指定的OSS文件对象地址

CreateLocationDateClusteringTask.description_en: The spatio-temporal clustering feature classifies files in a dataset based on their time and location. This feature works on indexed files, such as images and videos, that contain shooting time and location data. These classifications can represent content from a user's trip, where files have similar timestamps and locations. The classifications can also represent content shot at different places where a user lives or works. Analyzing the locations and time ranges of these classifications lets you categorize media files, create highlight reels, and generate photo and video stories
CreateLocationDateClusteringTask.description_zh: 时空聚类功能。可以将您已索引到数据集内的图片、视频等携带了拍摄时间、拍摄地点信息等文件，按照时间、地理位置进行分类。这些分类可以理解为用户的一次旅行所拍摄的内容（它们时间接近、地点接近），也可以理解为用户在不同生活、工作地的拍摄内容。通过获取、分析这些分类所在地点、所经历的时间范围，可以为用户提供媒体文件归类、精选、生成照片视频故事等能力

CreateMediaConvertTask.description_en: Create an asynchronous media transcoding task. This task processes audio and video files for media transcoding, media concatenation, video frame capture, and animated GIF generation
CreateMediaConvertTask.description_zh: 创建一个异步的媒体转码任务。提供媒体转码、媒体拼接、视频截帧、视频转动图等相关音视频媒体文件处理能力

CreateOfficeConversionTask.description_en: Creates a document conversion task that converts documents, such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and PDF files, stored in Object Storage Service (OSS) into images, text files, or PDF files
CreateOfficeConversionTask.description_zh: 创建文档转换任务，支持文档格式转换，将存储在对象存储中的文档（Word、PPT、Excel、PDF）转成图片，文本，或者PDF

CreateSimilarImageClusteringTask.description_en: The similar image clustering feature groups images that you have indexed in a dataset into clusters based on visual similarity. This feature is useful for scenarios such as deduplicating images or selecting the best shots. For example, you can use it to filter burst photos in an album
CreateSimilarImageClusteringTask.description_zh: 相似图片聚类功能，可以将您已索引到数据集内的图片按照相似度生成聚类，用于图片去重、选优等场景。例如可以通过该功能筛选相册中连拍的图片

CreateTrigger.description_en: Creates a trigger to start data processing in Intelligent Media Management (IMM). The trigger is activated by event sources, such as Object Storage Service (OSS), and uses data processing templates to process media files, such as images, videos, and documents
CreateTrigger.description_zh: 创建触发器任务，可通过OSS等事件源触发IMM数据处理，支持选择多种数据处理模板，对图片、视频、文档等媒体文件执行相应的处理

CreateVideoLabelClassificationTask.description_en: Detects labels for scenarios, objects, and events in video content. This feature supports more than 30 categories and thousands of labels. Scenario labels include natural landscapes, life scenes, and disaster scenes. Event labels include talent shows, office work, performances, and production. Object labels include tableware, electronic products, furniture, and vehicles
CreateVideoLabelClassificationTask.description_zh: 检测视频内容的场景、物体和事件标签信息。场景信息包括：自然景观、生活场景、灾难场景等大类；事件信息包括：才艺、办公、表演、生产等大类；物体信息包括：餐具、电子产品、家具、交通工具等大类；视频标签检测目前支持的标签种类包含三十多个分类、数千个标签

CreateVideoModerationTask.description_en: Detects threats or non-compliant content in videos. This operation can be used in scenarios such as pornography detection, terrorism and politically sensitive content detection, text and image violation detection, undesirable scene detection, and logo detection
CreateVideoModerationTask.description_zh: 检测视频中的风险或违规内容。具体包括以下场景：视频智能鉴黄、视频暴恐涉政、视频图文违规、视频不良场景、视频logo

DeleteBatch.description_zh: 删除指定的一个批处理任务

DeleteBinding.description_en: Deletes the binding between a dataset and an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket
DeleteBinding.description_zh: 删除数据集和对象存储（OSS）Bucket绑定任务

DeleteFileMeta.description_en: Removes the metadata of a file from a dataset
DeleteFileMeta.description_zh: 从数据集内删除文件的元信息

DetachOSSBucket.description_en: Unbinds an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket from the corresponding project
DetachOSSBucket.description_zh: 解除项目与OSS Bucket的绑定关系

DetectImageBodies.description_en: Detects human body information, such as the confidence level and body bounding box, in an image
DetectImageBodies.description_zh: 检测图片中的人体信息，包含置信度，人体边框等信息

DetectImageCars.description_en: Detects the outline data, attributes, and license plate information of vehicles in an image. The vehicle attributes include the vehicle color (CarColor) and vehicle type (CarType). The license plate information includes the recognition content (Content) and plate frame (Boundary)
DetectImageCars.description_zh: 检测指定图像中的车辆边界信息、车辆属性信息、车牌信息。车辆属性信息包括：车辆颜色（CarColor）、车辆类型（CarType）；车牌信息包括：车牌识别内容（Content）、车牌框信息（Boundary）

DetectImageCodes.description_en: Detects barcodes and QR codes in an image
DetectImageCodes.description_zh: 识别指定图像中的条码和二维码

DetectImageCropping.description_en: Detects visually optimal cropping regions in an image at a specified aspect ratio by using AI model capabilities
DetectImageCropping.description_zh: 通过AI模型能力在给定的目标图片比例下检测出视觉效果较好的裁剪框区域

DetectImageFaces.description_en: Detects faces from an image, including face boundary information, attributes, and quality. The boundary information includes the distance from the y-coordinate of the vertex to the top edge (Top), distance from the x-coordinate of the vertex to the left edge (Left), height (Height), and width (Width). Face attributes include the age (Age), age standard deviation (AgeSD), gender (Gender), emotion (Emotion), mouth opening (Mouth), beard (Beard), hat wearing (Hat), mask wearing (Mask), glasses wearing (Glasses), head orientation (HeadPose), attractiveness (Attractive), and confidence levels for preceding attributes. Quality information includes the face quality score (FaceQuality) and face resolution (Sharpness)
DetectImageFaces.description_zh: 检测指定图像中的人脸边界信息、属性信息、质量信息。边界信息（Boundary）包括：顶点Y坐标距离顶端距离（Top）、顶点X坐标距离左端距离（Left）、高度（Height）、宽度（Width）；属性信息包括：年龄（Age）、年龄标准差（AgeSD）、性别（Gender）、心情（Emotion）、是否张口（Mouth）、是否有胡子（Beard）、是否有帽子（Hat）、是否带口罩（Mask）、是否戴眼镜（Glasses）、头部朝向（HeadPose）、人脸吸引力（Attractive）及上述各属性的置信度；质量信息包括：人脸质量分（FaceQuality）、人脸清晰度（Sharpness）

DetectImageLabels.description_en: Detects scene, object, and event information in an image. Scene information includes natural landscapes, daily life, and disasters. Event information includes talent shows, office events, performances, and production events. Object information includes tableware, electronics, furniture, and transportation. The DetectImageLabels operation supports more than 30 different categories and thousands of labels
DetectImageLabels.description_zh: 检测图片中的场景、物体和事件标签信息。场景信息包括：自然景观、生活场景、灾难场景等大类；事件信息包括：才艺、办公、表演、生产等大类；物体信息包括：餐具、电子产品、家具、交通工具等大类。图片标签检测目前支持的标签种类包含三十多个分类、数千个标签

DetectImageScore.description_en: Calculates the aesthetics quality score of an image based on metrics such as the composition, brightness, contrast, color, and resolution. The operation returns a score within the range from 0 to 1. A higher score indicates better image quality
DetectImageScore.description_zh: 以主观美学为准评估图片的视觉质量，同时考虑构图、亮度、对比度、色彩、清晰度等多方面因素的影响。该功能返回一个范围为0-1的图片质量得分，得分越高则表示图片的视觉质量越高

DetectImageTexts.description_en: Recognizes and extracts text content from an image
DetectImageTexts.description_zh: 图片文本识别，将图片上的文字内容智能识别成为可编辑的文本

DetectMediaMeta.description_en: Retrieves the metadata of a media file, including media format information and media stream information
DetectMediaMeta.description_zh: 获取媒体文件元信息，包括媒体格式信息和媒体流信息

DetectTextAnomaly.description_en: Detects whether specified text contains anomalies, such as pornography, advertisements, excessive junk content, politically sensitive content, and abuse
DetectTextAnomaly.description_zh: 检测指定文本内容中是否包含色情、广告、灌水、涉政、辱骂等违规信息

EncodeBlindWatermark.description_en: Embeds specific textual information into an image as watermarks. These watermarks are visually imperceptible and do not affect the aesthetics of the image or the integrity of the original data. The watermarks can be extracted by using the CreateDecodeBlindWatermarkTask operation
EncodeBlindWatermark.description_zh: 将特定的文本信息嵌入到图片中，而这些信息在视觉观察下是不可见的。由于这些水印在视觉上是隐蔽的，它们不会影响图片的美观性或原始信息的传递，但可以通过 CreateDecodeBlindWatermarkTask 接口提取出来

ExtractDocumentText.description_zh: 提取文档文件正文中的文本

FuzzyQuery.description_en: Queries the extracted file metadata, including the file name, labels, path, custom tags, and other fields. If the value of a metadata field of a file matches the specified string, the metadata of the file is returned
FuzzyQuery.description_zh: 查询已提取的文件元数据（包含文件名、标签、路径、自定义标签等字段），只要文件元数据中有一个字段的值匹配指定字符串，该文件的元数据就会被返回

GenerateVideoPlaylist.description_en: Creates a just-in-time transcoding playlist that generates an M3U8 file from a video file, enables instant playback after playlist generation, and performs on-demand transcoding based on playback progress. Compared with offline transcoding, this significantly reduces transcoding wait time and greatly lowers transcoding and storage costs
GenerateVideoPlaylist.description_zh: 创建边转边播播放列表能够将视频文件生成m3u8文件，生成播放列表后即时播放，并根据播放进度实施按需转码，相比离线转码能极大减少了转码等待时间并大幅度降低了转码和存储开销

GenerateWebofficeToken.description_en: Retrieves the preview and editing credentials for a document
GenerateWebofficeToken.description_zh: 获取文档预览编辑凭证

GetBatch.description_en: Queries the information about a batch processing task

GetBinding.description_en: Queries the binding relationship between a specific dataset and an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket
GetBinding.description_zh: 查询指定的数据集和对象存储（OSS）Bucket绑定关系详情

GetDataset.description_zh: 查询一个数据集的信息

GetDecodeBlindWatermarkResult.description_en: Retrieves the result of a blind watermark extraction task for an image
GetDecodeBlindWatermarkResult.description_zh: 获取解析图片盲水印任务的结果

GetFigureCluster.description_en: Obtains basic information about face clustering, including the creation time, number of images, and cover
GetFigureCluster.description_zh: 获取人脸分组的基本信息，包括创建时间、照片数量、分组封面等信息

GetFileMeta.description_en: Queries metadata of a file whose metadata is indexed into the dataset
GetFileMeta.description_zh: 获取数据集内已完成索引的文件的元数据

GetImageModerationResult.description_en: Retrieves an image content moderation task
GetImageModerationResult.description_zh: 获取图片合规检测任务

GetOSSBucketAttachment.description_en: Retrieves the project name of a project that is bound to a specified OSS bucket in the same region
GetOSSBucketAttachment.description_zh: 获取同一地域下与指定OSS Bucket绑定的项目的项目名称

GetProject.description_en: Queries information about a specified project, including basic information and statistics information related to datasets and files
GetProject.description_zh: 查询指定项目（Project）的信息，包含基础信息，数据集（Dataset）和文件相关的统计信息等

GetTask.description_en: Queries the information about a specified asynchronous task. Intelligent Media Management (IMM) supports various asynchronous data processing capabilities, each with its own task creation operation, such as CreateFigureClusteringTask for creating figure clustering tasks and CreateFileCompressionTask for creating file compression tasks. This operation is a general-purpose operation that allows you to query the details of an asynchronous task by task ID and type
GetTask.description_zh: 该接口用于主动查询指定的异步任务信息。IMM支持多种异步数据处理能力，每种能力有各自创建任务的接口，例如创建人物人脸聚类任务CreateFigureClusteringTask、创建文件压缩任务CreateFileCompressionTask等。本接口为通用接口，可以通过任务ID和类型来查询异步任务的详细信息

GetTrigger.description_en: Queries the information about a trigger

GetVideoLabelClassificationResult.description_en: Retrieves the result of a video label detection task
GetVideoLabelClassificationResult.description_zh: 获取视频标签检测任务的结果

GetVideoModerationResult.description_en: Retrieves a video content moderation task
GetVideoModerationResult.description_zh: 获取视频合规检测任务

IndexFileMeta.description_en: Performs data processing on input files for tasks such as label detection, face detection, and location detection. This operation extracts object metadata and creates an index, which lets you retrieve data from a dataset
IndexFileMeta.description_zh: 对输入的文件进行数据处理如标签识别、人脸检测、地点检测等。将提取的文件元信息建立索引，支持用户在一个数据集内多样化的数据检索

ListAttachedOSSBuckets.description_zh: 查询项目（Project）所绑定的所有OSS Bucket信息

ListBatches.description_en: Queries batch processing tasks. You can query batch processing tasks based on conditions such task tags and status. The results can be sorted
ListBatches.description_zh: 查询批处理任务列表，支持排序，支持按照任务标签，任务状态等条件查询

ListBindings.description_en: Query the list of bindings between datasets and Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets
ListBindings.description_zh: 查询数据集和对象存储（OSS）Bucket绑定关系列表

ListDatasets.description_en: Queries a list of datasets. You can query the list by dataset prefix
ListDatasets.description_zh: 获取数据集列表，支持通过数据集名称前缀查询列表

ListProjects.description_en: Queries information about all projects, including basic information and statistics information related to datasets and files
ListProjects.description_zh: 查询所有项目（Project）的信息，包含基础信息，数据集（Dataset）和文件相关的统计信息等

ListRegions.description_zh: 查询支持IMM服务的Region列表信息，包括Region和对应语言的描述信息

ListTasks.description_en: Lists tasks based on specific conditions, such as by time range and by tag
ListTasks.description_zh: 该接口提供通过多种条件查询任务列表的功能。通过该接口可以查询指定时间范围内的任务、或者通过创建任务时指定的Tag搜索任务等

ListTriggers.description_en: Queries triggers by tag or status
ListTriggers.description_zh: 查询触发器任务列表，支持排序，支持按照任务标签，任务状态等条件查询

QueryFigureClusters.description_en: Queries face groups based on given conditions
QueryFigureClusters.description_zh: 根据条件查询人物聚类及其信息

QueryLocationDateClusters.description_en: Queries a list of spatiotemporal clusters based on the specified conditions
QueryLocationDateClusters.description_zh: 查询时空聚类列表信息，支持多种条件，详情请参考请求参数

QuerySimilarImageClusters.description_en: You can call this operation to query the list of similar image clusters
QuerySimilarImageClusters.description_zh: 查询相似图片聚类列表信息

QueryStories.description_en: Queries stories based on the specified conditions
QueryStories.description_zh: 根据条件查询故事及其信息

RefreshWebofficeToken.description_en: Refreshes a Weboffice access token. A Weboffice access token is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, you can no longer access Weboffice. To continue accessing Weboffice, call this operation to refresh the Weboffice access token and obtain a new token that is also valid for 30 minutes
RefreshWebofficeToken.description_zh: 刷新Weboffice访问凭证。Weboffice访问凭证有效期是30分钟，过期会失效，无法继续访问Weboffice。如果要继续访问Weboffice，可以使用这个接口刷新Weboffice访问凭证，即获取一个新的凭证，新的凭证过期时间也是30分钟

ResumeBatch.description_en: Resumes a batch processing task that is in the Suspended or Failed state
ResumeBatch.description_zh: 将一个Suspend（暂停）或Failed（失败）的批处理任务恢复

ResumeTrigger.description_en: Resumes a trigger that is in the Suspended or Failed state
ResumeTrigger.description_zh: 将一个Suspended（暂停）或Failed（失败）状态的触发器恢复

SearchImageFigureCluster.description_en: Queries face clusters that contain a specific face in an image. Each face cluster contains information such as bounding boxes and similarity
SearchImageFigureCluster.description_zh: 查询指定图片中所有人脸所在的人物聚类列表，每个人物聚类中包含人脸框，相似度等信息

SemanticQuery.description_en: Queries metadata in a dataset by inputting natural language
SemanticQuery.description_zh: 通过输入自然语言，对数据集内的元数据进行基于语义的查询搜索

SimpleQuery.description_en: Queries files in a dataset by performing a simple query operation. The operation supports logical expressions
SimpleQuery.description_zh: 查询和统计数据集内文件，支持逻辑关系表达方式

SuspendBatch.description_zh: 将一个 Running（正在执行）的批处理任务暂停

SuspendTrigger.description_zh: 将一个 Running（正在执行）状态的触发器暂停

UpdateBatch.description_en: Updates information for a batch processing task, such as the data source configuration, data processing configuration, and tags
UpdateBatch.description_zh: 更新批处理任务信息。如输入的数据源配置、数据处理的配置、批处理任务标签等信息

UpdateDataset.description_en: Updates the information of a dataset
UpdateDataset.description_zh: 更新一个数据集（Dataset）的信息

UpdateFigureCluster.description_en: Updates information about a face cluster, such as the cluster name and labels
UpdateFigureCluster.description_zh: 更新一个人脸聚类分组的信息，可以更新分组的名称、标签等信息

UpdateFileMeta.description_en: Updates the partial metadata of the indexed files in a dataset
UpdateFileMeta.description_zh: 更新数据集内已索引的文件的部分元数据

UpdateLocationDateCluster.description_zh: 更新一个时空聚类的信息

UpdateProject.description_en: Updates the information of a created project
UpdateProject.description_zh: 更新一个已创建项目（Project）的信息

UpdateStory.description_en: Updates the information about a story, such as the story name and cover image
UpdateStory.description_zh: 更新故事信息，例如重命名，修改封面等

UpdateTrigger.description_en: Updates information about a trigger, such as the input data source, data processing settings, and tags
UpdateTrigger.description_zh: 更新触发器信息，如输入的数据源配置、数据处理的配置、触发器标签等信息
